thread:
Alex K: Quick sync — Aurora Health just sent their final RFP spreadsheet. Need a short deliverable list for them by EOD so legal can wrap up. Specifically:
- Confirm which model variants we can support for their on-prem POC (FP16, 4-bit quantized, INT8 fallback).
- Expected sustained QPS per Dedicated GPU type (A10G / H100) for 512-token avg prompt.
- A simple pricing sketch (monthly reserved vs overage) and a note on data residency + KMS/HSM support.

Priya R: putting eng on it — @Samir can you own the model variant compatibility matrix? I'll draft pricing tiers and the security blurb.

Samir: Got it. I'll pull the runtime perf numbers and probe the H100 cluster this afternoon. What do they want for latency SLO?

Alex K: They flagged 95th perc < 300ms for interactive chat and cost targets that are ~40% below Vendor X. POC will be hybrid: private control plane + on-prem inference.

Samir: Ok. I'll run a quick micro-benchmark and paste numbers. Attaching preliminary notes.

Samir: ```
Perf notes (local):
- H100 (1x): 512 tokens, FP16 -> 120 qps sustained
- H100 (1x): 512 tokens, 4-bit LLM.int8 -> 85 qps sustained
- A10G (1x): 512 tokens, FP16 -> 35 qps sustained
- A10G (1x): 512 tokens, 4-bit -> 22 qps sustained
(bench harness: continuous batching, kv-cache warm)
```

Priya R: Thanks. I'll convert those to per-node pricing bands. Draft pricing snippet: `Reserved monthly (H100 pool): $XXk/mo node; On-demand tokens: $Y per 1M tokens` — will finalize after you confirm perf.

Natalie: Quick security check — Aurora wants attestation that keys never leave their KMS and an outline for audit logs. Priya, can you add the HSM/KMS paragraph? I have their sec questionnaire PDF ready to populate.

Priya R: Yep. Draft for sec: "Customer-managed KMS (AWS CloudHSM or Azure KeyVault HSM) integrated with Private control plane. Model artifacts encrypted at rest, keys not exported. Audit logs (immutable) for token access and operator actions available for 90 days; extended retention available as add-on." Will paste into the questionnaire.

Samir: One blocker: their on-prem infra is older — NICs are 10Gb and available RAM per node is borderline for 8k context. We should note a recommended minimum hw spec in the response.

Alex K: Good call. Add recommended spec: 2x H100 or 4x A10G equivalent, 100Gb network for distributed workloads, 512GB host RAM for large contexts. Mention fallback: we can host the heavy lifting in Redwood Dedicated if they prefer to avoid HW upgrades.

Natalie: For the RFP attachments, I've zipped the security questionnaire, a filled capability spreadsheet (work-in-progress), and a couple of sample eval prompts. Filename: `aurora_rfp_assets_v1.zip`. I'll upload to the share link once we finalize.

Samir: @eng-bot please create a short public perf snippet we can drop into the capability sheet (H100/A10G rows).

eng-bot: Created doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/perf-snippets/aurora-1719998888. Added H100/A10G numbers and notes about batching assumptions.

Priya R: I'll assemble the final response doc with three sections: 1) Capability matrix (models, quant support, perf), 2) Pricing/options (reserved/overage + migration to Dedicated), 3) Security & compliance (KMS/HSM, audit logs, SOC/ISO mentions).

Alex K: Two final asks before EOD: 1) call out any features not available in on-prem POC vs hosted (e.g., streaming with function-calls may need extra runtime hooks), 2) include a short migration/runbook attach for their infra team.

Samir: Noted. I'll add a `limitations` row in the matrix and a short runbook snippet: `runbook_onprem.md` — will push to the zip.

Natalie: I'll start populating the security questionnaire responses and flag anything legal needs to review.

Priya R: ETA EOD for PR ready draft. Dropping a placeholder snippet now for pricing table: ```
Plan,Monthly node,On-demand (per 1M tokens)
Reserved (H100 pool),$48,000,$2.50
Dedicated (A10G),$18,000,$3.60
Private on-prem (support add-on),$12,000 (platform fee),$4.00
```

Alex K: Perfect. Thanks team. I'll notify the AE and attach `aurora_rfp_assets_v1.zip` to the RFP portal once we have the final. :thumbsup:

Natalie: Uploading zip now to shared folder: https://files.redwood/sales/aurora/aurora_rfp_assets_v1.zip — contains `capability_matrix.xlsx`, `runbook_onprem.md`, `security_questionnaire_filled.pdf`, `eval_prompts.txt`.

Samir: Done with perf numbers and limitations row. Updated capability_matrix.xlsx in the zip.

Priya R: Draft ready — posting link for review: https://docs.redwood/sales/aurora/rfp-response-draft-1719998888. Please review comments by 5pm.

Alex K: Reviewing now. If no objections, I'll send to the customer at 5:30pm.

Natalie: Quick note for legal: we left SLA language as "SLA negotiable for Dedicated customers; standard hosted SLA applies to Redwood-hosted endpoints."

Alex K: Thanks all — great work.
